purpose: A CSS-only infinite marquee track. Three distinct instances, all 24s linear infinite, differing only in axis and in what they carry.

trusted-logos.seamlessness: the two rows are byte-identical; the duplication is what makes the loop seamless

capability-column.items: 3 headings (Create Images / Makes videos / Stays on-brand)

hero-slider.axis: VERTICAL at min-width 992px (--ty-end:-100%), HORIZONTAL at max-width 991px (--tx-end:-100%)
hero-slider.items: 6 labels (PDPs / UGC / Lifestyle shots / Ads / Stories / Street style)

responsive.base: hero slider scrolls vertically; both .how marquees run on their fixed axis
responsive.max-991px: the hero slider FLIPS to horizontal via the --tx/--ty custom properties - this is the only min-width:992px query in the project

notes: The .how marquee is masked at both ends by .how__bottom-gr-left / -gr-right, and the hero slider by .hero__slider__top-gr / __bottom-gr; all four use the surface.page-fade transparent companion colour.
